title: CozyNotes additive local desktop IPC contract v1
description: Tauri invoke commands and window-scoped events. Failures reject invoke with a string. These are local IPC operations, not HTTP endpoints. Existing commands retain their contracts. Reviewed contract is referenced by the implementation plan.

openOnStartup.description: Whether CozyNotes is registered to launch when the user signs in

savedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the saved version

document.description: Validated Tiptap document, including owned image asset identifiers

height.description: Expanded logical height; preserved while folded

set_note_favorite.behavior: Update an active note's favorite flag without changing its edit revision or timestamp. Emit note-favorite-changed. Favorites sort first in list_notes; within each group use the existing edit order. Favorites filtering is applied by the frontend to the current search/color result.

list_note_history.behavior: Return up to 100 earlier saved versions of an active note, newest revision first. A changed title/body save records the previous version atomically. Unchanged saves and favorites/window actions do not add history.

get_note_history.behavior: Read and validate one retained version for a read-only preview. Reject missing, pruned, unreadable, or unsupported versions.

response.description: The newly saved Note, with favorite=false and a fresh ID/revision

restore_note_history.behavior: Clone the retained document and its owned image assets into a new note titled with a (restored) suffix, emit note-created, and open it. Preserve the source note. If opening fails after save, return the saved note and queue an application error.

get_note_window_state.behavior: Derive note identity from the invoking native window. Read its current placement/folded state.

set_note_folded.behavior: Derive note identity from the native window. Resize to a non-resizable 52 logical pixel title strip or restore the expanded dimensions. The frontend saves drafts before requesting this action.

set_remember_desk.behavior: Persist the automatic reopening preference. Defaults to true, including for older settings files. Window placement is still retained when automatic reopening is disabled; only the startup reopen step is skipped. Failed writes preserve the previous effective value.

take_app_error.behavior: Consume the most recent native application error retained before opening or focusing the library. The library registers its app-error listener before reading this queued value so startup cannot lose an error. No pending error returns null.

set_note_defaults.behavior: Validate and persist the complete defaults group. Return canonical defaults only after a successful write. Failed saves preserve effective values and cached native reset dimensions. All other settings setters preserve this group. Blank-note creation snapshots these defaults; existing notes remain unchanged.

set_open_on_startup.behavior: Register or unregister CozyNotes with the operating system's user sign-in startup. The response reports the actual registration state. Defaults to disabled when no registration exists.

errors: Settings could not be persisted; the previous effective preference remains active
Another desktop operation is in progress

trash_notes.behavior: Deduplicate explicit IDs; reject empty/invalid/missing/already trashed IDs. Prepare affected open editors, require all successful acknowledgments, take fresh revision snapshots while prepared editors stay locked, and soft-delete the complete selection in one immediate SQLite transaction. No partial mutation. Emit one batch event and close affected editors after commit.
errors: A selected note no longer exists or is no longer active
An editor failed to save or did not respond

purge_notes.behavior: Validate the entire explicit selection is currently trashed and delete it atomically. The UI must confirm permanent deletion first.
errors: A selected note is not in Trash

editor_operation_active.behavior: True only if this native-issued operation is still active and expects the invoking editor window; derive identity from native Window, never a client-supplied note ID.

ack_editor_operation.behavior: Correlate the native operation ID and invoking editor with the pending request. Reject stale, duplicate or unexpected replies. Only successful acknowledgments from every expected editor permit a commit.

note-favorite-changed.behavior: Refresh library ordering and update the matching open note's favorite state.

prepare-editor-operation.behavior: Verify the operation with editor_operation_active; wait for existing local actions and IME composition; lock editing; flush autosave; acknowledge success while staying locked. Failure acknowledges false and preserves the draft.

finish-editor-operation.behavior: Only release the matching preparation after editor_operation_active confirms it is no longer active. Cancellation restores editing, including cancellation while awaiting IME or save. Committed editors are destroyed by native code after data is safe. If destruction fails, the saved editor remains permanently read-only, exposes a safe Close action, and can acknowledge a later explicit exit without flushing or unlocking the retired document.

notes-batch-changed.behavior: Refresh current library results once after commit.

library-show-notes.behavior: Show the Notes pane when the tray main-menu action is used.

app-error.behavior: Display an actionable error; native code records the latest error before showing/focusing the library. A newly created library consumes it with take_app_error after its listener is registered.

x-security: Application-local data only. New settings and batch commands require the native library window identity. Editor acknowledgments and status checks require their native editor identity and correlated IDs. Do not grant frontend tray APIs or broader native capability permissions. Validate all mutations again in Rust. No HTTP status codes, external authentication, pagination or rate limits apply to these local commands.
x-lifecycle: Default background true, conditional on successful tray creation. Close library hides in background mode. Disable background: hidden library is destroyed or recreated visibly so it cannot keep a windowless app alive; last real window closure exits normally. Explicit tray Exit coordinates all editor saves, cancels on failure/timeout, and exits only on success. Never await editor replies while holding a database or window-creation mutex. Block new window creation and conflicting destructive mutations during preparation. Native snapshots include current revision and storage batch checks it atomically.
